mathematics: Good exposed view and marked-pile support are invariant on the fine auxiliary fibers. Shared.SupportedAveraging is instantiated with S equal to the target coarse history intersected with good view; this restricts pointwise use to the chosen history without conditioning on S.
The resulting marked good-event bound retains the exact conditional marked-pile support probability. Good/bad decomposition charges H complement once per whole marked event.

Summing ordered embedding indicators is exactly a falling factorial count. Summing conditional pile support probabilities gives falling(pileSize,m), since pile size is deterministic even under the natural history.
initialPile_normalization converts falling(r,m)*q^[m(1-alpha)] to n^m*[(r/n)q]^[m(1-alpha)] in the correct direction, using alpha>=0. The ambient bad-event sum costs at most n^m epsilon.
Specializing m=1 and the literal tail-bin prefix identity yields actual forward prefixCount with C1=4/reserveMass, before all arrays and histories.
public_type_and_model: Ambient n in these modules is manuscript N: all Cuts, full row embeddings, and logarithmic horizons use n. First-pile size is separately pileSize.

prefixCount assumes alpha<1/2 as in source, positive natural history, actual historyGood, forward terminal direction and a strict future target cylinder. No residual law, count bound, denominator, or supplied concentration probability appears as a hypothesis.
The intermediate factorial theorem needs only alpha<1. Its m=2 prefix count is not yet the tail-equal-word collision theorem.
adversarial: Impossible marked pile membership contributes zero through the retained support; replacing this support by one would lose the required normalization and is not done.
Zero pile and zero tail mass are valid in the scalar normalization; positive terminal history already excludes an empty pile in the public application.
Null fine fibers are handled by total probability. Positive coarse history is used exactly to evaluate conditional expectation of a constant.
The count bad event is charged once per tuple, not per suffix word. Future tailCollisions must preserve this property before summing words.
remaining: Removable current copies, full-word tail collision sum with once-per-pair bad error, backward versions and exact future-cylinder law.
